definitions.gloss: to correct, to revise, to amend
definitions.explanation: To fix errors or inaccuracies in text, statements, or records.

examples.japanese: {間違|まちが}いを{訂正|ていせい}する。
{発言|はつげん}を{訂正|ていせい}させてください。
examples.english: Please allow me to correct my statement.

examples.japanese: {記事|きじ}の{誤|あやま}りが{見|み}つかったので、すぐに{訂正|ていせい}した。
examples.english: An error was found in the article, so it was corrected immediately.

notes:
{訂正|ていせい}する is composed of {訂|てい} (correct) + {正|せい} (right, correct).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: 〜を{訂正|ていせい}する

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {間違|まちが}いを{訂正|ていせい}する: to correct a mistake
- {誤字|ごじ}を{訂正|ていせい}する: to correct a typo
- {発言|はつげん}を{訂正|ていせい}する: to correct a statement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {訂正|ていせい}する: to correct (errors in text/statements)
- {修正|しゅうせい}する: to revise, to modify (broader, includes improvements)
- {直|なお}す: to fix (general, everyday)
